_catatan: Naskah explainer viralytics, diturunkan dari content/buklet.js (disetujui Farrez 9 Nov 2026).

gaya.id: Bacakan sebagai narator film dokumenter yang tenang, hangat, dan yakin, seperti video explainer sejarah. Tempo sedang, beri jeda panjang di antara paragraf.
gaya.en: Read as a calm, warm, confident documentary narrator, like a history explainer video. Medium pace, with a long pause between paragraphs.

teks.id: Sebuah agency menghubungkan brand dengan kreator. Satu kampanye melibatkan tim agency, perwakilan brand, dan banyak KOL.
teks.en: An agency connects brands with creators. One campaign involves the agency team, the brand, and many KOLs.

teks.id: Dulu brief, kontrak, dan invoice tersebar di spreadsheet dan grup WhatsApp.
teks.en: Briefs, contracts and invoices used to live in spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups.

teks.id: Status kampanye susah dilacak. Siapa sudah setuju, siapa belum dibayar, semuanya harus dicari di obrolan.
teks.en: Campaign status was hard to follow. Who approved, who is still unpaid: all of it buried in chats.

teks.id: Sekarang kampanye berjalan lewat tahap persetujuan yang jelas, dari brief sampai laporan. Kontrak, pembayaran KOL, dan invoice ada di satu tempat.
teks.en: Now campaigns move through clear approval stages, from brief to report. Contracts, creator payments and invoices sit in one place.

teks.id: Sistem ini sudah dipakai di produksi.
teks.en: The system is live in production.
